scenes.say: I asked three AIs to teach me AI agents like I'm fifteen. Then quiz me.
And I answered wrong on purpose.

scenes.label: ChatGPT
scenes.caption: built a whole quiz app. calm down.
scenes.say: ChatGPT built an entire quiz app. With a score table. Calm down. It still caught my wrong answer and explained why.

scenes.label: Claude
scenes.caption: agent = smart intern · 2/3, fair
scenes.say: Claude used a weekend trip to Jaipur, called an agent a smart intern, and graded me two out of three. Fair.

scenes.label: Gemini
scenes.caption: “Haha, nice try — there is no D!”
scenes.say: Gemini? I answered D. There was no D. Haha, nice try. There is no D. Caught me.
All three taught it well and graded me honestly. Ten, ten, ten.
The final scores drop this Saturday. Comment who you think won.
